entities.name: Zurgo Helmsmasher
entities.description: The orc khan of the Mardu who nurses a grudge against Sarkhan Vol and leads his horde into Temur territory for revenge.

entities.name: Varuk
entities.description: An old but clever orc, Zurgo's closest advisor, who turns the horde against him and leads it home to Wingthrone.

entities.name: Batar Throatslasher
entities.description: A human wing leader with shields fitted with bone dragon claws who challenges Zurgo and is killed.

entities.name: Rufaz
entities.description: A female orc and one of Zurgo's three top wing leaders who doubts the march into Temur lands.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker and former Mardu who burned his clanmates with dragonfire when his spark ignited, now hated by Zurgo and seeking the Spirit Dragon's tomb.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: The Temur khan whose forces attack the Mardu and whom Zurgo intends to punish.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The warrior clan led by Zurgo that rules the plains and values unity.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: The clan of the mountains and forests whose warriors fight the Mardu with ambushes and weather magic.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan Vol fought against while still Mardu.

entities.name: Wingthrone
entities.description: The Mardu home territory to which Varuk leads the horde.

entities.name: Spirit Dragon's tomb
entities.description: A rumored resting place of the Spirit Dragon in the Temur mountains where Vol is said to have gone.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the clans fight.

events.summary: Zurgo surveys the Mardu army after defeating a Temur force and rallies it with a victory speech.
events.quote: Surrak has tested our borders," he shouted, "and we have shown him that they are strong.

events.summary: A goblin protests that Zurgo's broken rock was taken at the cost of his sister's life, and Zurgo stomps him to death to protect his authority.
events.quote: Zurgo raised his left foot as high as he could, then stomped on the goblin, dropping all his weight onto it.

events.summary: A messenger reveals the Temur attacked because a man calling himself Sarkhan turned into a dragon in Temur forests and the Temur mistook him for the new Mardu khan.
events.quote: He…they say he turned into a dragon. And breathed fire on them, took off, and flew farther into Temur territory.

events.summary: Zurgo declares Vol must die, and Varuk warns he is too dangerous, recalling Vol's desertion and dragonfire against the Mardu army.
events.quote: I was there when he turned into a great flying beast of flame and roasted your army with his breath.

events.summary: Zurgo plans to hide his real aim by marching the horde into the mountains to punish Surrak, despite his wing leaders' objections.
events.quote: Tomorrow, we move into the mountains," he said to them. "We will punish Surrak for his impudence.

events.summary: Unnatural snow falls as the Mardu enter the mountain valley, and Batar urges Zurgo to turn back.
events.quote: My khan, we must turn back. This is absurd. We are riding into a trap.

events.summary: Temur raiders strike the center of the Mardu line twice and vanish into the woods, killing over a hundred Mardu.
events.quote: Fifty Temur arranged in a column broke into our line, killed fifty-six, and disappeared back into the woods.

events.summary: Zurgo gives three young warriors new names for their first kills: Headtaker, Heartpiercer, and Neckwringer.
Batar challenges Zurgo for leadership of the clan.
events.quote: I challenge you for the right to lead this clan.

events.summary: Zurgo defeats Batar in single combat and kills him, stomping his head.
events.quote: Zurgo ran his sword straight through Batar's chest, threw the limp form to the ground, and stomped his great foot on the man's head.

events.summary: Varuk declares that Zurgo's horde fears him rather than serves him, and the horde follows Varuk home to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
events.quote: They once served you. Now they only fear you. And that means that you are not truly their khan.

events.summary: Left alone, Zurgo resolves to kill Vol, refusing to wipe Batar's blood from his blade until it mixes with Vol's.
events.quote: He would not clean it until it had mixed with Vol's.

events.summary: Zurgo kills a dying Temur woman after learning Vol went toward the Spirit Dragon's tomb, then rides there alone.
events.quote: He plunged his sword into the woman's throat and she stopped moving.

events.summary: Zurgo's riding-beast breaks a leg, and he leaves it to die and continues on alone.
events.quote: Zurgo left it to die and continued alone.

relations.note: He is the khan of the Mardu, until the horde abandons him.
relations.quote: Zurgo, khan of the Mardu, knows how to nurse a grudge.

relations.note: Varuk is Zurgo's closest advisor, until he turns against him.
relations.quote: an old but clever orc standing nearby who served as Zurgo's closest advisor

relations.note: Zurgo hates Vol and swears to kill him.
relations.quote: He has threatened this clan enough. He must die.

relations.note: He kills Batar in a challenge duel.
relations.quote: Zurgo ran his sword straight through Batar's chest, threw the limp form to the ground, and stomped his great foot on the man's head.

relations.note: They fight in the valley and plains.
relations.quote: Some were Mardu, but the great majority were Temur.
